top_signals.title: Russia’s largest bank forecasts $46 billion in first-year crypto exchange trading under new rules: report
top_signals.summary: Sberbank's forecast comes as the country's new crypto regulations are set to take effect on Sept. 1, 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan to lower residential road speed limit from 60 to 30 kph
top_signals.summary: The measure aims to reduce accidents in urban areas with pedestrian-heavy narrow streets, marking a major shift as they account for around 70% of ordinary roads nationwide.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Prices of 4,923 food and drink items set to rise in September, extending trend
top_signals.summary: The number of affected items is up about threefold from a year earlier, and is set to be the fourth-largest rise on record and the highest monthly total so far in 2026.
